title: Web3 Play Store
tagline: Decentralised and censorship resistant platform for hosting apps
description: Our aim is to provide decentralised and censorshiped resistant platform for the developer around the world to host there apps, and also anyone in globe should be able to download the apps hosted on our web3 platform. Platform aims to provide end to end solution for the app developer to publish there apps in decentralised storage so that any intermediary authority is removed and no single point of failure by making avaiable in the decentralised storage for eternity.  User around the globe are often tracked and gaurded by the authoritative power present in their geography, to which app they are allowed to use which could often lead to voliating basic rights such as free speech, free flow of data for social and greater good. Our platform is intends to solve the problems at  both the ends i.e user who want to use the different application and developers who want to reach all over the globe by building exciting apps. We intend to empower both the ends by making the our platform available on the decentralised network so that never in future there is way to hamper the choices of common man to choose which application they use and build.
how_its_made: Primarily we ran into two problems, one is app registery which need to be eventually highly secure and yet transactions being cost efficient L2 chains seems to have rescued us. We have levereged ploygon chain for maintaing this app registery which have perfectly solved for security and reliablity at the same time. Other problem was to have all the data corresponding to the application need to storage in decentralised storage and yet being verifiable at the same time. We have leveraged Filecoin web3.storage to store the data in verifiable form in public network build over ipfs.
